format_evidence: CEDA supports HTTP range reads on the tested 2024 monthly SPEI NetCDF4. Its 3 × 450 × 900 chunks allow direct access: the March value near Lilongwe (+0.07) required about 0.65 MB of a 44.2 MB file. Other workflows may benefit from different chunk sizes.
licence_and_conditions: UK Open Government Licence v3 permits copying, adaptation and redistribution. Acknowledge the source: “Contains data supplied by UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology.”
access_evidence: A reader retrieved data from the reviewed distribution without credentials, a form or paid access.
inventory_scope: CEDA deposit: 13,500 annual NetCDFs across both fits plus one README. Bytes are the sum of the listed files. The EIDC landing page separately quotes “approx. 111.8Gb” for this same route; the discrepancy is unresolved.
verification: CEDA inventory traversal across 327 directories returned 13,500 NetCDFs + one README and 1,286,676,254,727 bytes. HTTP ranges (655,360 bytes of 44,241,243) decoded reference March 2024 three-month SPEI = +0.07 at 33.75°E, 13.95°S. EIDC lists OGL v3 and “approx. 111.8Gb”.
owner_questions: What release or quantity does EIDC’s “approx. 111.8Gb” describe relative to the complete CEDA manifest?
